estilo: Classic 2D stickman cartoon, clean thick black line art, round white head, simple expressive face, flat warm colors, simple but cinematic background, high readability, no text, 16:9.

elenco.narrador: Stickman narrator wearing a brown explorer hat (safari style), friendly curious expression.
elenco.farao: Stickman pharaoh wearing a striped blue and gold nemes headdress and a gold false ceremonial beard, regal posture.
elenco.sacerdote: Stickman ancient Egyptian priest with a shaved head and a flowing white linen robe, calm solemn expression.
elenco.campones: Stickman ancient Egyptian peasant farmer wearing a white linen loincloth and carrying a woven basket.
elenco.escriba: Stickman ancient Egyptian scribe holding a papyrus scroll and a reed pen, sitting or standing attentively.
elenco.soldado: Stickman ancient Egyptian soldier holding a leather shield and a spear, alert stance.
elenco.rainha: Stickman ancient Egyptian queen wearing a slim golden crown with a cobra at the forehead and a long flowing white and gold gown, elegant posture.
elenco.general_estrangeiro: Stickman foreign general wearing a plumed bronze helmet and a short red cape, holding a round shield, confident stance.
